prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years building full-stack, AI-integrated enterprise tools end to end. Built a LangGraph agent with RAG on pgvector, LLM evals, and human approval steps, deployed on Cloudflare and Docker. Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients. Built database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.

bullets.text: Architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module in React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores job postings against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector and drafts documents behind a human approval step.
Shipped the agent with FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, Postgres, Langfuse tracing, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI with 70 tests and an eval gate.
Built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python pipeline that finds local businesses via Google Places and scores AI visibility, with a Google Sheets CRM and draft-only outreach behind human approval.
Engineered tycodes.dev on Cloudflare Workers with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, running a Hono Worker that calls Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audits and pricing models.
Enforced evidence-cited outputs with a verify loop and layered prompt injection defense, gated in CI on zero unsupported claims and passing injection tests.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Built database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Achieved top-performer status by securing 50+ qualified meetings per month, and set an organizational record of 120+ booked meetings in a single month.
Mentored and onboarded incoming representatives to attain 15%+ conversion rate benchmarks.
